title: Mattituck
summary: Mattituck is the name of a village, bay, and creek in Southold. The placename remains attached to a living North Fork hamlet and its surrounding waterways.
translation_content:
Mattituck is interpreted as no tree or badly wooded, from elements glossed as no and tree. Nabiachage is interpreted as place of the divided or separated hills, matching the creek landscape between high ground on either side.

Why Place Names Matter

“Place names are the living memory of the historical landscape.”

— Cosmin Ivașcu and Nils Stanik, Placenames and Toponymy (2024), Practicing Historical Ecology, chapter opening

Place-name history should show Native people as active and present, not only as names in old documents.
whereintheworld_content: Map location note: the pin is placed in Mattituck near the creek and hamlet center to represent the village, bay, and creek association; it is not an exact historical boundary.
